entities.summary: Earl Winty Thomas III is an American former professional football player who was a safety in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas Longhorns and received consensus All-American honors and played in the 2010 BCS National Championship Game. He left after his redshirt sophomore year and he was selected by the Seattle Seahawks in the first round of the 2010 NFL draft. During his time with the Seahawks, he made six Pro Bowls and five All-Pro teams as he was a core member of the Legion of Boom defense, winning Super Bowl XLVIII against the Denver Broncos and starting in Super Bowl XLIX.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Earl Thomas was a core member of the Legion of Boom defense and won Super Bowl XLVIII with the Seattle Seahawks, contributing to the team's championship victory. His six Pro Bowls and five All-Pro teams demonstrate his significant impact on the NFL.
